mood: Landscape painted sci-fi tableau: a broken turquoise threshold stands offset left, apart from a dominant compact black armored fragment entwined with ivory bones. Broad blue sky separates them. A smaller suspended island holds cream drapery, pale flesh, gold urn, bowed peacock, fruit and flowers. A pale cratered disk and thin cloud threads link the groups; rust-lit recesses, fine reproduction grain.
